Proposed W6 recipe primary candidate. No Indic score given.

dots.mocr (rednote-hilab mirror): 3B multilingual parse-anything VLM, MIT, Kannada/Tibetan demos; olmOCR-bench 83.9 with Old-scans 48.2 and Old-scans-math 85.5; vLLM CUDA-only, MLX UNKNOWN. Proposed head-to-head vs GLM-OCR (needs Indic bench first).

MonkeyOCRv2-B-Parsing 0.7B: #1 MDPBench 83.3 across 17 languages incl. Hindi 71.9; Apache-2.0 code AND weights; CPU support 2026-08-22; FT instructions. Proposed smallest strong fine-tunable backbone (fits 32GB).

HunyuanOCR 1.5 (0.9B, 4K res): 'Agentic Data Flow' targets low-resource + ancient-script OCR (analogue to Ol Chiki/Nastaliq); llama.cpp GGUF local; Tencent Hunyuan Community License (not pure OSS) - license review REQUIRED before use.

mlx-tune (ARahim3): MLX-native SFT/DPO/GRPO fine-tuning for VLMs incl. GLM-OCR, DOTS-OCR, olmOCR-2, DeepSeek-OCR; ships CER/WER metrics; Apache-2.0, Apple Silicon. Named 'THE QLoRA tool' for W6 conditional-training path (D1); replaces hand-rolled scripts. Note: Mac/MLX-only vs plan's portable PyTorch.

DeepSeek-OCR-2 (3B): CONTRADICTION on local runnability - repo README says runnable; mlx-tune README says needs mlx-vlm>=0.4 -> transformers>=5.0, 'not loadable anywhere'. Verdict: watch, do not block W6.
light-ocr (arcships): PP-OCRv6 packaged with CoreML for Apple Silicon, proposed as fast local detection stage; details UNKNOWN (existence only).

liteparse (run-llama): Rust model-free PDF parsing (PDFium), pluggable OCR-server backends, worker pool; benchmarked on M2 Max 32GB; Apache-2.0. Proposed PDF front-end for wrap pipeline (relevant to searchable-PDF output).
deepseek-ocr.rs (Rust multi-backend OCR/VLM server, OpenAI-compatible, no Python) noted as lean local-serving option; created 2025-10-25 outside scan window.
